faq_heading: Homes near Sunrise Ridge Elementary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Sunrise Ridge Elementary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school, and the sold prices are measured by distance. Surrey School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Sunrise Ridge Elementary home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active homes whose listing text names Sunrise Ridge Elementary, so a nearby home that leaves the name out will not show.

faq.q: How much do homes near Sunrise Ridge Elementary sell for?
faq.a: Within 1 km of the school, 80 homes sold between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026. Medians were houses $1,255,000. A median is the middle price and is shown where at least 5 homes sold.

faq.q: How fast do homes sell near Sunrise Ridge Elementary?
faq.a: Within 1 km of Sunrise Ridge Elementary the median was 16 days on the market, closing at 96.7% of the list price, with 5% of sales above the list price for the 80 homes within 1 km.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Sunrise Ridge Elementary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Bibleway Christian Academy (0.1 km north-west), Martha Currie Elementary (0.7 km south-west) and Don Christian Elementary (0.8 km north-west).

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Sunrise Ridge Elementary

20 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Sunrise Ridge Elementary in a straight line (12 elementary, 5 secondary, 3 other; 4 independent). The closest is Bibleway Christian Academy, 0.1 km away, and the farthest on this list is Regent Road Elementary, 2.9 km away. By type, the nearest elementary school is Martha Currie Elementary (0.7 km); the nearest secondary school is Lord Tweedsmuir Secondary (1.5 km); the nearest school listing a French Immersion program is Martha Currie Elementary (0.7 km). Other elementary schools close by: Martha Currie Elementary (0.7 km south-west), Don Christian Elementary (0.8 km north-west), Latimer Road Elementary (1.0 km east), Hillcrest Elementary (1.1 km north), Adams Road Elementary (1.9 km north-west). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-7) is Martha Currie Elementary, 0.7 km south-west of Sunrise Ridge Elementary.

blocks.text: Before you offer on a home near Sunrise Ridge Elementary

items.t: Confirm the catchment for the exact address on the Surrey school finder. A home a few blocks from Sunrise Ridge Elementary can sit in a different catchment.
Go past Sunrise Ridge Elementary on a school morning and again mid-afternoon to see the traffic, parking and noise before you offer.

Compare price with similar homes farther from the school. The median house within 1 km of Sunrise Ridge Elementary was $1,255,000, so check whether size and age explain a gap before you pay for the location.
Look at Martha Currie Elementary, the nearest other elementary school, 0.7 km south-west of Sunrise Ridge Elementary. Compare the two when you check which school serves the address.
